name: scriptcable
description: One TypeScript core (compiled by scriptc) → type-safe clients for Bun, Node, Deno, Tauri, React Native, Lynx, Cloudflare Workers, Vite, and Next.js

scripts.build: bun run --filter @scriptcable/types --filter @scriptcable/core --filter @scriptcable/node --filter @scriptcable/bun --filter @scriptcable/testing --filter @scriptcable/vite --filter @scriptcable/webpack --filter @scriptcable/next --filter @scriptcable/react-native --filter @scriptcable/tauri --filter @scriptcable/lynx --filter @scriptcable/expo --filter @scriptcable/cli build && bun run --filter '@unikit-bridge/scriptcable' build
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/scriptcable/dist packages/*/dist-test examples/*/.scriptcable examples/*/node_modules/.cache
